NEWS UPDATE: The Assumption College San Lorenzo removed the image of Senator Loren Legarda from its "Wall of Empowered Women" in protest of her ascent into the new Senate majority led by Sen. Alan Cayetano.

"No public office grants immunity from the standards of ethical conduct. Any act that enables impunity and obstruction of justice, however subtle or procedural, diminishes public trust, and compromises the dignity of institutions that serve the Filipino people," the statement wrote. /Rolando Ng III

More details to follow at https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI
